scope: Existing canonical Poaceae accepted name, historical synonyms/ranks and hybrid/identity holds only; county nativity DEFERRED.
backbone: Kew POWO/WCVP 2026 checked 2026-10-25; 1997 New Phytologist and Mao & Huff 2012 Crop Science primary evolutionary research; no voucher or photo identity determination.

scientific_decisions.reason: POWO/WCVP 2026 accepts annual bluegrass at species rank in Poaceae, original Linnaean name (1753); existing canonical binomial is correct.
Homotypic genus combination under POWO, not a separately accepted learner species.
Synonym under POWO; alternative German Flora variety-rank concept separately documented as unresolved authority disagreement.
Historical infraspecific name synonymized under accepted P. annua; not a new accepted taxon.
Separate accepted species under POWO/WCVP; no automatic identity merger with P. annua L.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Poa annua Schltdl. & Cham. (1831), nom. nud.
scientific_decisions.reason: POWO lists this author-dependent, not-validly-published name under P. infirma, NOT the accepted Linnaean P. annua L.; preserve author and nomenclatural invalidity.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Poa annua var. exilis Tomm. ex Freyn.
scientific_decisions.reason: Historical variety maps to separately accepted P. infirma under POWO.
Historical variety maps to separately accepted P. infirma under POWO.
Separate accepted species under POWO; also implicated in published evolutionary origin of P. annua.
Homotypic historical variety maps to accepted P. supina, not P. annua L.
Historical variety maps to accepted P. supina, not P. annua L.
Separate accepted species in POWO; its historical P. annua variety combination must retain rank/source provenance.
Homotypic synonym of separately accepted P. maroccana under current POWO, not a P. annua synonym; older sources cited P. infirma as an alternative.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Poa annua L. evolutionary allotetraploid origin
scientific_decisions.reason: Mao & Huff (2012) nuclear/plastid data support an allotetraploid origin involving P. infirma (maternal) and P. supina; 1997 crossing study independently supports parental relationship. Evolutionary origin does not require a multiplication sign in the accepted species name and does not prove the ancestry of any particular image.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Bulk synonymization of all historical Poa annua varieties
scientific_decisions.reason: Reject: historical P. annua varieties map under POWO to at least P. annua, P. infirma, P. supina, and P. maroccana. Author and rank matter.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Equating Poa annua Schltdl. & Cham. (nom. nud.) with Poa annua L.
scientific_decisions.reason: Reject conflating author-dependent 1831 nomen nudum listed under P. infirma with validly published Linnaean 1753 accepted species.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Existing Poa annua learner photographs and observations
scientific_decisions.reason: Accepted nomenclature alone does not authenticate individual images/specimens against close Poa taxa. Preserve existing photo identity and anatomy verification holds.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Individual contemporary hybrid, cultivar, ecotype or parentage assignment
scientific_decisions.reason: Established historical allotetraploid ancestry of the species is not proof that any particular plant is a recent F1, a particular cultivar, or of a known independent origin. No specimen-specific voucher/genetic evidence reviewed.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Poa annua var. raniglumis alternative rank
scientific_decisions.reason: POWO currently synonymizes it under P. annua, whereas Flora Germanica (2022) recognized variety rank. Record the competing classification without creating a duplicate accepted learner entry.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Historical Poa annua var. maroccana source concepts
scientific_decisions.reason: POWO current accepted destination is P. maroccana; its page cites older 2006 World Grass Species treatment under P. infirma. Historical specimen concepts cannot be assigned by name string alone.

scientific_holds_preserved: Existing individual specimen and photo identifications are not certified by name mapping
Evolutionary allotetraploid ancestry is not a claim of particular photographed plant F1/cultivar identity
No county nativity audit; no native metrics changed

next_handoff: Retain P. annua L. as accepted species, do not collapse historical Poa annua author/rank variants; keep P. infirma, P. supina and P. maroccana separate; preserve individual identification holds.
